normal.cn: 对方案的反对，可以是一句低语，也可以是一次投票。

normal.en: Disapproving looks travel faster than speeches.
normal.cn: 不以为然的眼神，比长篇大论传得更快。

normal.en: The word judges the act, not the person who does it.
normal.cn: 这个词评判的是行为，不是做这事的人。

abstract.en: Picture a cup set down harder than it needs to be.
abstract.cn: 想象一只茶杯被放得比需要的更重。

abstract.en: Picture two lips pressed into a thin line.
abstract.cn: 想象两片嘴唇抿成一条细线。

abstract.en: Picture a red stamp falling on a page.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚红章落在纸页上。

examples.en: He shook his head in disapproval.
examples.cn: 他不以为然地摇了摇头。

examples.en: The idea met with strong disapproval from the staff.
examples.cn: 这个想法遭到员工的强烈反对。

examples.en: She ignored her mother's silent disapproval.
examples.cn: 她没有理会母亲无声的不赞成。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 disapproval 记成「的士不认」：的士司机不认这条路，摆摆手表示不赞成，就是 disapproval。

root: 由否定前缀 dis- 加 approval 构成。approval 来自拉丁语 approbare（检验后认为好），词根 probare 意为检验、证明。加上否定前缀后，表示认为某事不妥的内心判断，也可指公开表达的反对，甚至正式的否决。

sensesIntro.en: From a silent judgement, to a spoken objection, to an official refusal.
sensesIntro.cn: 从无声的判断，到说出口的反对，再到正式的否决。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cup set down, and a mouth closed tight.
core.cn: 核心意象：茶杯放下，嘴紧紧闭上。

branches.en: The first sense is the quiet judgement inside.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是心里那个安静的判断。

branches.en: The second sense is the judgement spoken aloud.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是被说出口的判断。

branches.en: The third sense is the judgement given official force.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是被赋予官方效力的判断。

branches.en: The feeling and the objection differ only in volume.
branches.cn: 内心态度与公开反对，只差一个音量。

branches.en: A public voice becomes a decision once it is stamped.
branches.cn: 公开的声音一盖章，就成了决定。

intro.en: Disapproval gathers the approve family, words about judging and consent.
intro.cn: disapproval 聚起 approve 一族词，围绕评判与认可。

latinIntro.en: Latin probare, to test or prove, underlies approve, approval and disapproval.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 probare（检验、证明）是 approve、approval 与 disapproval 的底层词根。

items.meaning: a judgement that something is wrong
items.example: She looked at the mess with disapproval.
items.exampleCN: 她看着那堆乱东西，一脸不赞成。

items.example: The plan won the approval of the board.
items.exampleCN: 方案获得了董事会的批准。

items.example: The manager approved the request.
items.exampleCN: 经理批准了这个请求。

items.example: His father disapproved of the trip.
items.exampleCN: 他父亲不赞成这趟出行。

items.example: She gave an approving nod.
items.exampleCN: 她赞许地点了点头。

items.example: He gave the letter a disapproving glance.
items.exampleCN: 他不以为然地瞥了那封信一眼。

items.meaning: in a way that shows approval
items.example: The teacher smiled approvingly.
items.exampleCN: 老师赞许地笑了。

items.meaning: in a way that shows disapproval
items.example: She looked at him disapprovingly.
items.exampleCN: 她不以为然地看了他一眼。

definition_en: to think that something is wrong or unacceptable
core_image: 一只手在桌下轻轻摆了摆，示意别再往下说
scene: 他刚提到辞职，母亲就放下了手里的针线。My father disapproves of late nights.
sceneCN: 这里 disapproves 指「不赞成」（第 1 个义项：认为不妥）；句意是我父亲不赞成熬夜。

senses.title: To judge an act as wrong
senses.definition: to think that a person's behaviour is not acceptable
senses.definitionCN: 认为某人的行为不可接受
senses.example: My father disapproves of late nights.
senses.exampleCN: 我父亲不赞成熬夜。
senses.why: The judgement comes first, and the sentence comes after.
senses.whyCN: 判断先到，话后到。

senses.title: To be against an idea
senses.definition: to think that a plan or idea should not go forward
senses.definitionCN: 认为某个计划或想法不该推进
senses.example: Most of the staff disapproved of the new rule.
senses.exampleCN: 大多数员工反对这条新规定。
senses.why: A plan is stopped in the mind before it is stopped in the office.
senses.whyCN: 计划先在脑子里被拦下，才在办公室里被拦下。

senses.title: To refuse official consent
senses.definition: to officially decide not to accept a request or a budget
senses.definitionCN: 正式决定不接受某项请求或预算
senses.example: The committee disapproved the new budget.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会没有批准新预算。
senses.why: The same judgement, once signed, closes a door.
senses.whyCN: 同一种判断，一签上字就关上了一扇门。

intro.en: Disapprove is dis- plus approve, whose Latin base approbare meant to test something as good.
intro.cn: disapprove 是 dis- 加 approve，其拉丁词基 approbare 指检验后认为好。

items.en: Probare meant to test, to prove or to judge.
items.cn: probare 指检验、证明或判断。

items.en: Approbare added ad- and meant to approve a thing.
items.cn: approbare 加上 ad-，表示认可某物。

items.en: Approve entered English with the sense of proving or commending.
items.cn: approve 进入英语时，指证明或称赞。

items.en: Disapprove reversed the judgement into a refusal.
items.cn: disapprove 把这份认可反转为否定。

items.en: The verb now covers private views and official decisions.
items.cn: 这个词既指私下看法，也指官方决定。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the approve stem, while the meaning group names other ways of saying no.
note.cn: 形近组共用 approve 这一段词干，近义组则列出其他说「不」的方式。

entries.definition: to think that something is good
entries.definitionCN: 认为某事好

entries.definition: a favourable judgement or consent
entries.definitionCN: 赞许的判断或同意

entries.definition: a judgement that something is wrong
entries.definitionCN: 认为某事不妥的判断

entries.definition: to say that one is against something
entries.definitionCN: 表示反对某事

entries.definition: to act against a plan or a person
entries.definitionCN: 采取行动反对某计划或某人

entries.definition: to regard something with clear disapproval
entries.definitionCN: 对某事明显不赞成

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a hand waved under a table to a stamp that is never given.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从桌下摆了一下的手，走到始终没有盖下的那枚章。

normal.en: Dis- plus approve: the approval is refused.
normal.cn: dis- 加 approve：认可被拒绝。

normal.en: A father disapproves with a look before a word.
normal.cn: 父亲往往先用眼神表示不赞成，然后才开口。

normal.en: Disapprove of a habit, and you judge the act, not the person.
normal.cn: 不赞成一种习惯，评的是行为，不是人。

normal.en: A committee can disapprove a budget with one vote.
normal.cn: 委员会一次投票就能不批准预算。

normal.en: The word leaves the thing standing, but withholds the yes.
normal.cn: 这个词让事情立着，却把那个「同意」扣下了。

abstract.en: Picture a hand waving low, out of sight.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在低处、在别人看不见的地方摆了摆。

abstract.en: Picture lips pressed while the eyes stay steady.
abstract.cn: 想象嘴唇抿紧，眼睛却一动不动。

abstract.en: Picture a form returned without a signature.
abstract.cn: 想象一份表格被退回，上面没有签名。

examples.en: My father disapproves of late nights.
examples.cn: 我父亲不赞成熬夜。

examples.en: The committee disapproved the new budget.
examples.cn: 委员会没有批准新预算。

examples.en: She disapproved of the way he spoke to the waiter.
examples.cn: 她不赞成他那样跟服务员说话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 disapprove 记成「的士不认」：司机不认这条路，摆手说不，就是不赞成。

root: 由否定前缀 dis- 加 approve 构成。approve 来自拉丁语 approbare（检验后认为好），词根 probare 意为检验、证明。加前缀后表示认为某事不妥，既可指私下的态度，也可指公开反对，甚至正式不予批准。

sensesIntro.en: From a private judgement of an act, to opposition to an idea, to an official no.
sensesIntro.cn: 从对行为的私下判断，到对想法的反对，再到官方的一声「不」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand waved low, telling someone to stop.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手在低处摆动，示意停下。

branches.en: The first sense is a judgement of behaviour.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是对行为的判断。

branches.en: The second sense is a stand against an idea.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是对某个想法的抵制。

branches.en: The third sense is the official refusal to consent.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是官方拒绝同意。

branches.en: A habit and a plan can both meet the same closed face.
branches.cn: 一种习惯和一个计划，可能撞上同一张合起来的脸。

branches.en: A spoken no becomes a formal no once it is recorded.
branches.cn: 说出的「不」一旦被记下，就成了正式的「不」。

intro.en: Disapprove belongs to the approve family, words about judging and consenting.
intro.cn: disapprove 属于 approve 一族，围绕评判与同意。

latinIntro.en: Latin probare, to test or prove, gives the prove in approve and disapprove.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 probare（检验、证明）给出 approve 与 disapprove 里的 prove。

items.example: They disapprove of the way the land is used.
items.exampleCN: 他们不赞成这块地的用法。

items.example: The board approved the design.
items.exampleCN: 董事会批准了这个设计。

items.example: The plan is waiting for approval.
items.exampleCN: 方案正等着批准。

items.meaning: a judgement that something is wrong
items.example: His silence was a form of disapproval.
items.exampleCN: 他的沉默就是一种不赞成。

items.example: She gave an approving smile.
items.exampleCN: 她赞许地笑了笑。

items.example: The teacher gave a disapproving look.
items.exampleCN: 老师投来不以为然的目光。

items.meaning: in a way that shows approval
items.example: He nodded approvingly at the plan.
items.exampleCN: 他赞许地对方案点了点头。

items.meaning: in a way that shows disapproval
items.example: She glanced disapprovingly at the mess.
items.exampleCN: 她不以为然地瞥了一眼那堆乱东西。

definition_en: an event that causes great damage or suffering, or a complete failure
core_image: 风暴过后，屋顶掀开一半，一把椅子挂在树枝上
scene: 水退到脚踝，墙上留着一条深色的线，家具全倒了。The flood was the worst disaster in the town's history.
sceneCN: 这里 disaster 指「灾难」（第 1 个义项：造成巨大损失的事件）；句意是这场洪水是该镇历史上最严重的灾难。

senses.title: An event of great harm
senses.definition: a sudden event such as a flood or fire that causes great damage
senses.definitionCN: 洪水、火灾之类突然造成巨大损失的事件
senses.example: The flood was the worst disaster in the town's history.
senses.exampleCN: 这场洪水是该镇历史上最严重的灾难。
senses.why: The world keeps its shape, but people lose theirs.
senses.whyCN: 世界还保持着形状，人的日子却散了。

senses.title: A complete failure
senses.definition: a plan or event that fails completely
senses.definitionCN: 彻底失败的计划或活动
senses.example: The concert was a disaster from the first note.
senses.exampleCN: 那场音乐会从第一个音起就是一场灾难。
senses.why: Nobody is hurt, and yet everything has fallen down.
senses.whyCN: 没有人受伤，可所有东西都塌了。

senses.title: A hopeless person
senses.definition: a person who is completely unable to do something well
senses.definitionCN: 完全做不好某件事的人
senses.example: He is a disaster in the kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 他在厨房里简直一塌糊涂。
senses.why: The word lends its ruin to one clumsy pair of hands.
senses.whyCN: 这个词把自己的废墟，借给了一双笨手。

intro.en: Disaster came from Italian disastro, literally an ill star, and carried the old belief that stars shaped events.
intro.cn: disaster 来自意大利语 disastro，字面是「凶星」，带着星辰左右世事的旧观念。

items.en: Astrum meant a star, and astronomy read the sky for signs.
items.cn: astrum 指星辰，占星与天象之学都从天上找征兆。

items.en: Disastro joined dis-, bad, to astro, star.
items.cn: disastro 把表示「坏」的 dis- 与 astro（星）合在一起。

items.en: Desastre carried the word into French with the same sense.
items.cn: desastre 以同样的意思把词带进法语。

items.en: English disaster named a calamity blamed on an unlucky star.
items.cn: 英语 disaster 指归咎于凶星的灾祸。

items.en: The star faded, and the word kept only the ruin.
items.cn: 星辰的意味淡去，这个词只留下了废墟。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by a letter or two, while the meaning group names other large misfortunes.
note.cn: 形近组只差一两个字母，近义组则列出其他巨大的不幸。

entries.definition: a large dry area of land with little rain
entries.definitionCN: 雨水稀少的干旱大地

entries.definition: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal
entries.definitionCN: 餐后吃的甜食

entries.definition: causing great harm or failure
entries.definitionCN: 造成巨大损害或失败的

entries.definition: an event that causes great and sudden suffering
entries.definitionCN: 造成巨大而突然苦难的事件

entries.definition: a serious misfortune that brings deep distress
entries.definitionCN: 带来深切痛苦的严重不幸

entries.definition: a very sad event, especially one involving death
entries.definitionCN: 极悲惨的事件，尤指涉及死亡的

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a storm over a town to a kitchen ruined by one cook.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从笼罩小镇的风暴，走到被一个厨子弄乱的厨房。

normal.en: Dis- plus aster: a bad star was once blamed for every ruin.
normal.cn: dis- 加 aster：从前每场废墟都怪一颗凶星。

normal.en: A natural disaster arrives without asking.
normal.cn: 自然灾害从不先打招呼。

normal.en: A party can be a disaster and still be remembered fondly.
normal.cn: 一场聚会可能是灾难，却仍被人笑着记住。

normal.en: Disaster relief arrives after the water, not before.
normal.cn: 救灾总是在水来之后，而不是之前。

normal.en: One clumsy cook can turn a kitchen into a disaster area.
normal.cn: 一个笨厨子就能把厨房变成灾区。

abstract.en: Picture a roof half lifted off a house.
abstract.cn: 想象屋顶被掀开了一半。

abstract.en: Picture a chair hanging from a tree branch.
abstract.cn: 想象一把椅子挂在树枝上。

abstract.en: Picture a dark line left high on a wall by water.
abstract.cn: 想象墙上高处留着一条水退后的深色线。

examples.en: The earthquake was a disaster for the whole region.
examples.cn: 这场地震对整个地区是一场灾难。

examples.en: Poor planning turned the event into a disaster.
examples.cn: 糟糕的筹划把这场活动变成了灾难。

examples.en: Several disasters struck the coast that year.
examples.cn: 那一年海岸遭遇了好几次灾害。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 disaster 记成「地砸死他」：地一塌，砸下来，就是一场灾难。

root: 来自意大利语 disastro，字面意思是「凶星」，由表示坏的 dis- 与 astro（星辰）组成。古人相信星辰决定祸福，于是把大祸归因于星象。这个词经法语进入英语后，星辰的意味逐渐淡去，只留下灾难与彻底失败的意思。

sensesIntro.en: From a flood that ruins a town, to an evening that ruins itself, to a cook who ruins dinner.
sensesIntro.cn: 从毁掉小镇的洪水，到自我毁掉的夜晚，再到毁掉晚饭的厨子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a house with its roof half gone and a chair in the tree.
core.cn: 核心意象：屋顶没了一半，椅子挂在树上。

branches.en: The first sense is the great event that harms many.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是伤害许多人的巨大事件。

branches.en: The second sense is a failure with no injury.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是没有伤人却彻底失败的事。

branches.en: The third sense lends that ruin to one hopeless person.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这片废墟借给一个没救的人。

branches.en: A flood and a concert can both end in the same wreckage.
branches.cn: 洪水和音乐会，都可能收在同样的残局里。

branches.en: A failed evening and a failing cook share one word.
branches.cn: 失败的夜晚和失败的厨子，共用一个词。

intro.en: Disaster opens the star family: disaster, disastrous, and the astro- words.
intro.cn: disaster 打开了「星辰」一族：disaster、disastrous 以及 astro 系列。

latinIntro.en: Latin astrum, star, and Greek astron, star, give the astro- base in this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 astrum 与希腊语 astron 都指星辰，给出这一族的 astro 词基。

items.example: The fire was a disaster for the village.
items.exampleCN: 那场火对村子是一场灾难。

items.example: The decision had a disastrous effect.
items.exampleCN: 那个决定造成了灾难性的后果。

items.meaning: in a way that causes ruin
items.example: The plan failed disastrously.
items.exampleCN: 计划灾难性地失败了。

items.meaning: a small rocky body in space
items.example: An asteroid passed close to the earth.
items.exampleCN: 一颗小行星从地球附近掠过。

items.meaning: the study of stars and their supposed influence
items.example: She reads astrology for fun.
items.exampleCN: 她看占星只是图个乐。

items.meaning: the scientific study of stars and space
items.example: He teaches astronomy at the university.
items.exampleCN: 他在大学教天文学。

items.example: The astronomer mapped the southern sky.
items.exampleCN: 那位天文学家绘制了南天星图。

items.meaning: a star-shaped mark used in printing
items.example: A small asterisk marks the note.
items.exampleCN: 一个小星号标出了注释。

definition_en: a flat round object, a disc that stores sound or data, or a pad between bones
core_image: 一片薄薄的圆盘在灯下转，边缘反出一圈白光
scene: 唱机的手臂落下，圆盘开始转，屋里响起沙沙的底噪。He slid the disc into the player.
sceneCN: 这里 disc 指「光盘」（第 1 个义项：扁圆形的存储介质）；句意是他把光盘推进了播放机。

derivatives.zh: 迪斯科舞曲；迪斯科舞厅

senses.title: A round carrier of sound or data
senses.definition: a thin round object on which music or computer data is stored
senses.definitionCN: 存着音乐或电脑数据的薄圆片
senses.example: He slid the disc into the player.
senses.exampleCN: 他把光盘推进了播放机。
senses.why: A whole evening of sound hides in one shiny circle.
senses.whyCN: 一整个晚上的声音，藏在一个发亮的圆里。

senses.title: Any flat round object
senses.definition: a flat circular thing, such as a plate of metal
senses.definitionCN: 扁平的圆形物体，如一片金属盘
senses.example: The machine cuts a disc from the steel sheet.
senses.exampleCN: 机器从钢板上切下一个圆盘。
senses.why: The shape is older than any use people found for it.
senses.whyCN: 这个形状比人给它找的任何用途都更老。

senses.title: A pad between bones
senses.definition: a soft round pad that sits between the bones of the spine
senses.definitionCN: 夹在脊椎骨之间的软圆垫
senses.example: A damaged disc can press on a nerve.
senses.exampleCN: 受损的椎间盘会压到神经。
senses.why: Even the body keeps small round cushions between hard parts.
senses.whyCN: 连身体也要在硬骨之间垫上小圆垫。

intro.en: Disc goes back through Latin discus to Greek diskos, a flat round plate thrown in games.
intro.cn: disc 经拉丁语 discus 追溯到希腊语 diskos，指比赛中掷出的扁圆盘。

items.en: Diskos named a quoit, a flat stone or metal plate thrown in sport.
items.cn: diskos 指比赛里掷出的扁石盘或金属盘。

items.en: Discus borrowed the Greek word for the same object.
items.cn: discus 借来这个希腊词，指同样的东西。

items.en: Disc and disk entered English for a flat round surface.
items.cn: disc 与 disk 进入英语，指扁平的圆面。

items.en: Records and then compact discs gave the word a musical life.
items.cn: 唱片与后来的激光唱片，让这个词有了音乐的生命。

items.en: It now also names a cushion between spinal bones.
items.cn: 如今它也指脊椎骨之间的软垫。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the disc- shape, while the meaning group names other round flat things.
note.cn: 形近组共用 disc 这一形状词干，近义组则列出其他扁圆之物。

entries.definition: a flat round object or a computer storage device
entries.definitionCN: 扁圆物，或电脑存储盘

entries.definition: a style of dance music with a strong beat
entries.definitionCN: 节奏强烈的迪斯科舞曲

entries.definition: a heavy disc thrown in an athletics event
entries.definitionCN: 田径比赛中掷出的重圆盘

entries.definition: a flat round dish used for food
entries.definitionCN: 盛食物的扁圆盘

entries.definition: a round plastic disc that carries recorded sound
entries.definitionCN: 录有声音的圆形塑料唱片

entries.definition: a large flat plate, or an old record disc
entries.definitionCN: 大平盘，或旧式唱片

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a spinning plate of sound to a soft pad inside the spine.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从旋转的发声圆盘，走到脊椎里的软垫。

normal.en: Disc is a shape before it is a thing.
normal.cn: disc 先是一个形状，然后才是一件东西。

normal.en: A disc jockey turns two round plates into a night.
normal.cn: 唱片骑师把两张圆盘转成一个夜晚。

normal.en: Scratch a disc and the music stumbles.
normal.cn: 光盘一划伤，音乐就会打结。

normal.en: A slipped disc is a small cushion out of place.
normal.cn: 椎间盘突出，就是一个小软垫挪了位。

normal.en: The same round shape serves music, machines and the body.
normal.cn: 同一个圆形，服务音乐、机器与身体。

abstract.en: Picture a thin silver circle catching the light.
abstract.cn: 想象一个薄薄的银圆接住灯光。

abstract.en: Picture a needle settling into a groove.
abstract.cn: 想象唱针落进一道细槽。

abstract.en: Picture two bones with a soft round pad between them.
abstract.cn: 想象两块骨头之间垫着一个软圆垫。

examples.en: He slid the disc into the player.
examples.cn: 他把光盘推进了播放机。

examples.en: The disc was scratched and skipped.
examples.cn: 光盘划伤了，播放时跳音。

examples.en: The doctor found a damaged disc in her back.
examples.cn: 医生发现她背部有一处椎间盘受损。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 disc 记成「碟斯克」：碟子一样的圆片，就是 disc。

root: 来自希腊语 diskos（掷出的扁圆盘），经拉丁语 discus 进入英语，最初指扁平的圆面。后来唱片、激光光盘先后借用这个词，使它有了承载声音与数据的意思；医学上又用它指脊椎骨之间的软垫。

sensesIntro.en: From a shiny circle that holds music, to any flat round plate, to a cushion inside the spine.
sensesIntro.cn: 从装着音乐的亮圆片，到任何扁圆盘，再到脊椎里的软垫。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin round plate spinning under a light.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片薄圆盘在灯下旋转。

chain: DATA IS BURNED IN TINY DOTS
A SOFT PAD SITS BETWEEN BONES

branches.en: The first sense is the round carrier of sound or data.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是承载声音或数据的圆片。

branches.en: The second sense is the bare shape itself.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是那个形状本身。

branches.en: The third sense is the body's own small disc.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是身体里自带的小圆盘。

branches.en: Music and metal both borrow the same flat circle.
branches.cn: 音乐与金属借用了同一个扁圆。

branches.en: A pad between bones is a disc no one can see.
branches.cn: 骨间的软垫，是一只看不见的圆盘。

intro.en: Disc gathers a family of round and flat words, from disks to discus.
intro.cn: disc 聚起一族与圆、扁有关的词，从磁盘到铁饼。

latinIntro.en: Greek diskos and Latin discus, a thrown plate, give the base disc-.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊语 diskos 与拉丁语 discus（掷出的圆盘）给出词基 disc。

items.example: The disc lay face down on the desk.
items.exampleCN: 那张光盘正面朝下放在桌上。

items.meaning: a flat round object or storage device
items.example: The file is saved on the disk.
items.exampleCN: 文件存在磁盘上。

items.example: The party played disco all night.
items.exampleCN: 聚会整晚都在放迪斯科。

items.meaning: a heavy disc thrown in sport
items.example: He threw the discus across the field.
items.exampleCN: 他把铁饼掷过了场地。

items.meaning: a person who plays recorded music
items.example: The disc jockey kept the crowd dancing.
items.exampleCN: 唱片骑师让全场一直跳着。

items.meaning: a machine part that reads discs
items.example: The disc drive would not open.
items.exampleCN: 光驱打不开了。

items.meaning: brakes that press on a round plate
items.example: The bike has disc brakes on both wheels.
items.exampleCN: 这辆车的两个轮子都装了盘式刹车。

items.meaning: having the form of a flat circle
items.example: The nest was disc-shaped and shallow.
items.exampleCN: 那个巢是浅盘状的。

definition_en: to throw something away because it is no longer wanted
core_image: 楼道口一只旧沙发，坐垫裂开，露出里面的黄海绵
scene: 搬家的人把旧箱子一件件抬到楼下，堆在墙边。They discarded the broken chairs behind the shop.
sceneCN: 这里 discarded 指「丢弃」（第 1 个义项：当作没用的东西扔掉）；句意是他们把坏椅子扔在店后面。

senses.title: To throw an object away
senses.definition: to get rid of something that is broken or no longer wanted
senses.definitionCN: 把坏掉或不再需要的东西处理掉
senses.example: They discarded the broken chairs behind the shop.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把坏椅子扔在店后面。
senses.why: The hand lets go, and the object becomes someone else's problem.
senses.whyCN: 手一松，那件东西就成了别人的麻烦。

senses.title: To give up an idea or plan
senses.definition: to stop considering a plan or belief as useful
senses.definitionCN: 不再认为某个计划或想法有用
senses.example: The team discarded the first design.
senses.exampleCN: 团队放弃了第一版设计。
senses.why: An idea can be dropped as easily as a torn coat.
senses.whyCN: 一个想法，可以像破外套一样被丢下。

senses.title: To lay down a card
senses.definition: to put down a card that is no longer needed in a game
senses.definitionCN: 在牌局中打出不再需要的牌
senses.example: He discarded a low card and kept the ace.
senses.exampleCN: 他打出一张小牌，留下了爱司。
senses.why: What leaves the hand still lies on the table.
senses.whyCN: 离开手的东西，仍旧躺在桌上。

intro.en: Discard is dis-, away, plus card, a piece of stiff paper, and first meant to throw out a card.
intro.cn: discard 是 dis-（离开）加 card（硬纸片），最初指把牌打出去。

items.en: Charta meant paper or a written sheet.
items.cn: charta 指纸或写字的纸页。

items.en: Carta named a playing card in Italian games.
items.cn: carta 在意大利的牌戏里指一张牌。

items.en: Carte carried the same sense into French card games.
items.cn: carte 把同样的意思带进法国牌戏。

items.en: To discard was to throw a card out of the hand.
items.cn: discard 最初指把一张牌从手里打出去。

items.en: The verb widened to any object or idea thrown away.
items.cn: 这个词后来扩展到任何被扔掉的东西或想法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the disc- opening, while the meaning group names other ways of letting things go.
note.cn: 形近组共用 disc 这一开头，近义组则列出其他放手的方式。

entries.definition: disagreement or a harsh mixture of sounds
entries.definitionCN: 不合，或刺耳的声音混杂

entries.definition: a style of dance music with a strong beat
entries.definitionCN: 节奏强烈的迪斯科舞曲

entries.definition: a heavy disc thrown in athletics
entries.definitionCN: 田径比赛中掷出的重圆盘

entries.definition: to get rid of something in a careless way
entries.definitionCN: 随便地把东西处理掉

entries.definition: to leave something behind for good
entries.definitionCN: 把某物永久地留下不管

entries.definition: to cancel or throw out something useless
entries.definitionCN: 取消或扔掉无用的东西

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a chair left by a wall to a card laid on a table.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从靠墙丢下的椅子，走到摊在桌上的一张牌。

normal.en: Dis- plus card: the card leaves the hand.
normal.cn: dis- 加 card：那张牌离开了手。

normal.en: Old chairs are discarded where nobody has to look.
normal.cn: 旧椅子总被丢在没人愿意看的地方。

normal.en: A plan can be discarded before it costs a penny.
normal.cn: 一个计划可以在花一分钱之前就被放弃。

normal.en: In a card game, discarding is a way of choosing.
normal.cn: 在牌局里，打出一张牌也是一种选择。

normal.en: What is discarded is not always worthless.
normal.cn: 被丢掉的东西，并不总是没有价值。

abstract.en: Picture a sofa with its cushion split open.
abstract.cn: 想象一只沙发的坐垫裂开了。

abstract.en: Picture a box left against a wall in the rain.
abstract.cn: 想象一只箱子被丢在墙边淋雨。

abstract.en: Picture one card sliding face up across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一张牌正面朝上滑过桌面。

examples.en: They discarded the broken chairs behind the shop.
examples.cn: 他们把坏椅子扔在店后面。

examples.en: The team discarded the first design.
examples.cn: 团队放弃了第一版设计。

examples.en: He discarded a low card and kept the ace.
examples.cn: 他打出一张小牌，留下了爱司。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 discard 记成「的士卡的」：的士被卡在路上，乘客干脆丢下行李走了，就是丢弃。

root: 由表示「离开」的 dis- 加 card（纸牌）构成，字面就是「把牌打出去」。这个词先用于牌戏，指打出不要的牌；后来扩展到把旧物扔掉，再进一步指放弃想法、计划或习惯。

sensesIntro.en: From a broken chair left by a wall, to an idea dropped by a team, to a card laid on the table.
sensesIntro.cn: 从墙边丢下的坏椅子，到团队放弃的想法，再到摊在桌上的牌。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand opening and letting an object fall away.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手松开，让东西落下去。

chain: A HAND HOLDS AN OLD CHAIR

branches.en: The first sense is an object thrown away.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是被扔掉的实物。

branches.en: The second sense is an idea given up.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是被放弃的想法。

branches.en: The third sense is a card put down in a game.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是牌局里打出的一张牌。

branches.en: Things and plans both become lighter once dropped.
branches.cn: 东西和计划一旦丢下，都会变轻。

branches.en: A thrown chair and a played card both leave the hand.
branches.cn: 扔掉的椅子和打出的牌，都离开了手。

intro.en: Discard belongs to the card family, words about paper, maps and games.
intro.cn: discard 属于 card 一族，围绕纸片、图与牌戏。

latinIntro.en: Latin charta, paper, gives card and its relatives, including discard.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 charta（纸）给出 card 及其亲属词，包括 discard。

items.example: Do not discard the receipt.
items.exampleCN: 别把收据扔了。

items.example: She wrote the address on a card.
items.exampleCN: 她把地址写在一张卡片上。

items.meaning: thick stiff paper used for boxes
items.example: The books came in a cardboard box.
items.exampleCN: 书装在一个纸板箱里。

items.example: The chart shows the rise in prices.
items.exampleCN: 图表显示了物价的上涨。

items.example: The city was founded by royal charter.
items.exampleCN: 这座城依王室特许状建立。

items.example: The cups are cheap and discardable.
items.exampleCN: 这些杯子便宜，用完就可扔。

items.example: A discarded tyre lay in the ditch.
items.exampleCN: 一条被丢弃的轮胎躺在沟里。

items.example: Discarding old files saves space.
items.exampleCN: 清理旧文件能省出空间。

definition_en: to release a substance, a person or a duty, or the substance that is released
core_image: 水管口喷出一股白水，落在石头上溅起一片雾
scene: 工厂的管子对着河面，水色发灰，岸边浮着一层沫。The factory was fined for discharging waste into the river.
sceneCN: 这里 discharging 指「排放」（第 1 个义项：把液体或气体排出）；句意是这家工厂因向河里排放废物被罚款。

senses.title: To let a substance flow out
senses.definition: to release liquid, gas or waste into the environment
senses.definitionCN: 把液体、气体或废物排到环境里
senses.example: The factory was fined for discharging waste into the river.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂因向河里排放废物被罚款。
senses.why: The pipe does not ask the river whether it wants the water.
senses.whyCN: 管子不问河水要不要这些水，只管往外放。

senses.title: To allow someone to leave
senses.definition: to allow a patient, soldier or prisoner to leave officially
senses.definitionCN: 正式允许病人、军人或囚犯离开
senses.example: She was discharged from hospital on Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 她周五出院了。
senses.why: The door opens only when someone with authority says it may.
senses.whyCN: 那扇门，只有在有权的人说可以时才会开。

senses.title: To carry out a duty or pay a debt
senses.definition: to perform a duty fully or to pay what is owed
senses.definitionCN: 把职责做到底，或把欠的还清
senses.example: He discharged his duties without complaint.
senses.exampleCN: 他毫无怨言地履行了职责。
senses.why: A load is set down only when nothing is left on it.
senses.whyCN: 只有什么都不剩了，肩上的担子才算卸下。

intro.en: Discharge came from Old French deschargier, to unload, built on chargier, to load, and Latin carrus, a cart.
intro.cn: discharge 来自古法语 deschargier（卸货），词基 chargier 意为装载，更早是拉丁语 carrus（车）。

items.en: Carrus named a four-wheeled cart.
items.cn: carrus 指四轮货车。

items.en: Carricare meant to load a cart or a beast.
items.cn: carricare 指往车上或牲口背上装货。

items.en: Chargier meant to load, and deschargier meant to unload.
items.cn: chargier 指装载，deschargier 指卸下。

items.en: Discharge first meant to unload goods or a ship.
items.cn: discharge 最初指卸货或卸船。

items.en: The word widened to waste, patients, soldiers and duties.
items.cn: 这个词后来扩展到废物、病人、军人与职责。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the charge stem, while the meaning group names other kinds of letting go.
note.cn: 形近组共用 charge 这一段词干，近义组则列出其他放手的说法。

entries.definition: to load, to ask a price, or to accuse
entries.definitionCN: 装载、收费或指控

entries.definition: a device that puts power into a battery
entries.definitionCN: 给电池充电的装置

entries.definition: to put fresh power into a battery
entries.definitionCN: 给电池重新充电

entries.definition: to let a person or substance go free
entries.definitionCN: 让人或物质自由离开

entries.definition: to send out light, sound or gas
entries.definitionCN: 发出光、声音或气体

entries.definition: to send someone away or remove them from a job
entries.definitionCN: 让某人离开，或解除其职务

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a pipe pouring into a river to a duty finally paid in full.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从往河里灌水的管子，走到终于还清的职责。

normal.en: Dis- plus charge: the load is taken off.
normal.cn: dis- 加 charge：把担子卸下来。

normal.en: A pipe discharges; a ward discharges; a soldier is discharged.
normal.cn: 管子排放，病房放人，军人退役，都是这个词。

normal.en: To discharge a duty is to leave nothing owed.
normal.cn: 履行职责，就是把欠的都清掉。

normal.en: The river carries away what the pipe lets go.
normal.cn: 管子放出的东西，由河水带走。

normal.en: The word always means a load leaving a place.
normal.cn: 这个词始终意味着：有一份重量离开了原处。

abstract.en: Picture grey water spreading under a pipe.
abstract.cn: 想象灰水在管口下面散开。

abstract.en: Picture a hospital door opening for a walking patient.
abstract.cn: 想象病房的门为一个能走路的病人打开。

abstract.en: Picture an empty cart with its wheels still turning.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆空车，轮子还在转。

examples.en: The factory was fined for discharging waste into the river.
examples.cn: 这家工厂因向河里排放废物被罚款。

examples.en: She was discharged from hospital on Friday.
examples.cn: 她周五出院了。

examples.en: He discharged his duties without complaint.
examples.cn: 他毫无怨言地履行了职责。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 discharge 记成「的士查值」：的士到站查完值就卸客，人货一起放出去。

root: 来自古法语 deschargier（卸货），由表示「去除」的 des- 加 chargier（装载）构成，更早可追到拉丁语 carrus（车）。本义是把货从车上卸下，后来引申为排出液体与气体、准许病人或军人离开，以及履行完职责、还清债务，仿佛卸下肩上的重担。

sensesIntro.en: From waste leaving a pipe, to a patient leaving a ward, to a duty leaving a person's shoulders.
sensesIntro.cn: 从离开管口的废物，到离开病房的病人，再到离开肩头的职责。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pipe pouring out, and a cart standing empty.
core.cn: 核心意象：管子往外倒，车子空了下来。

chain: A DUTY IS PAID IN FULL

branches.en: The first sense is a substance let out.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是被放出来的物质。

branches.en: The second sense is a person allowed to go.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是被准许离开的人。

branches.en: The third sense is a load of duty carried to the end.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是扛到底、终于卸下的职责。

branches.en: Water and people both leave through an opening.
branches.cn: 水与人，都是从某个出口离开。

branches.en: Leaving a post and finishing a duty are two ends of one service.
branches.cn: 离开岗位与完成职责，是同一段服务的两头。

intro.en: Discharge belongs to the charge family, words about loading, cost and command.
intro.cn: discharge 属于 charge 一族，围绕装载、费用与命令。

latinIntro.en: Latin carrus, a cart, gives carricare, to load, and through French the base charge.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 carrus（车）给出 carricare（装载），再经法语形成词基 charge。

items.example: The pipe discharges into the sea.
items.exampleCN: 这根管子把水排进海里。

items.meaning: to load, to ask a price, or to accuse
items.example: They charge ten pounds for the tour.
items.exampleCN: 这趟参观收费十英镑。

items.example: My phone charger stopped working.
items.exampleCN: 我的手机充电器坏了。

items.example: He recharged the battery overnight.
items.exampleCN: 他给电池充了一夜电。

items.meaning: to ask too high a price
items.example: The taxi driver tried to overcharge us.
items.exampleCN: 出租车司机想多收我们的钱。

items.meaning: an extra amount added to a price
items.example: There is a surcharge for late payment.
items.exampleCN: 迟付要交附加费。

items.meaning: loaded with power or filled with feeling
items.example: The room felt charged with anger.
items.exampleCN: 屋里弥漫着愤怒的紧张气氛。

items.meaning: the act of loading or supplying power
items.example: The phone is charging on the desk.
items.exampleCN: 手机正在桌上充电。

definition_en: training that produces obedience and control, a field of study, or punishment
core_image: 操场上鞋跟并拢的响声，一排人影在晨光里排成直线
scene: 天还没亮，哨声一响，所有人从床上弹起，几十秒后站成四列。Good discipline kept the team calm under pressure.
sceneCN: 这里 discipline 指「纪律」（第 1 个义项：让人守规矩的约束）；句意是良好的纪律让团队在压力下保持冷静。

senses.title: Training that makes people obey
senses.definition: training and rules that produce order and self-control
senses.definitionCN: 带来秩序与自制的训练和规则
senses.example: Good discipline kept the team calm under pressure.
senses.exampleCN: 良好的纪律让团队在压力下保持冷静。
senses.why: A line of people moves as one only when each one holds still.
senses.whyCN: 一排人只有各自站住，才能像一个整体那样动。

senses.title: A field of study
senses.definition: a branch of knowledge studied in school or research
senses.definitionCN: 在学校或研究中钻研的一个知识分支
senses.example: She studies two disciplines at once.
senses.exampleCN: 她同时学两门学科。
senses.why: A mind in training is organised like a body in training.
senses.whyCN: 受训的心，和受训的身体一样有条理。

senses.title: To punish and correct
senses.definition: to train someone by punishment or firm control
senses.definitionCN: 用惩罚或严格管束来训练某人
senses.example: The teacher disciplined the class firmly.
senses.exampleCN: 老师严格管教了这个班。
senses.why: The word turns from the rule into the hand that enforces it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从规矩本身，转成执行规矩的那只手。

intro.en: Discipline comes from Latin disciplina, instruction, from discere, to learn, and discipulus, a learner.
intro.cn: discipline 来自拉丁语 disciplina（教导），词根 discere 意为学习，discipulus 指学习者。

items.en: Discere meant to learn, and discipulus meant a learner.
items.cn: discere 指学习，discipulus 指学习者。

items.en: Disciplina named teaching, knowledge and orderly conduct.
items.cn: disciplina 指教导、知识以及有秩序的行为。

items.en: Discipline carried the sense of instruction and correction.
items.cn: 这个词在古法语里兼指教导与纠正。

items.en: English discipline meant training, especially of the mind.
items.cn: 英语里的 discipline 指训练，尤指心智的训练。

items.en: It widened to a field of study and to punishment.
items.cn: 它后来扩展到学科，也指惩罚。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the discip- stem, while the meaning group names order, training and correction.
note.cn: 形近组共用 discip 这一段词干，近义组则区分秩序、训练与纠正。

entries.definition: a person who follows and learns from a teacher
entries.definitionCN: 跟随老师学习的弟子

entries.definition: connected with the punishment of faults
entries.definitionCN: 与惩戒过失有关的

entries.definition: able to control one's own behaviour
entries.definitionCN: 能控制自己行为的

entries.definition: the process of teaching a skill through practice
entries.definitionCN: 通过练习教授技能的过程

entries.definition: a state in which everything is in its right place
entries.definitionCN: 万物各在其位的状态

entries.definition: a penalty given for a wrong act
entries.definitionCN: 对错误行为施加的惩处

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a whistle at dawn to a subject that trains the mind.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从黎明的一声哨响，走到一门训练心智的学问。

normal.en: Discipline and disciple share a root: both are about learning.
normal.cn: discipline 与 disciple 同根，都和学习有关。

normal.en: A line of shoes on a field is discipline you can see.
normal.cn: 操场上排齐的鞋，是看得见的纪律。

normal.en: Self-discipline is a whistle nobody has to blow.
normal.cn: 自律是一声不需要别人吹的哨。

normal.en: A discipline is also a subject, trained like a muscle.
normal.cn: 学科也是一门功夫，要像肌肉一样练。

normal.en: To discipline a child is to teach, not only to punish.
normal.cn: 管教孩子是为了教，不只是为了罚。

abstract.en: Picture four rows of shadows standing perfectly still.
abstract.cn: 想象四排影子一动不动地站着。

abstract.en: Picture a whistle cutting through cold morning air.
abstract.cn: 想象一声哨响划过清冷的晨空。

abstract.en: Picture a notebook filled with the same careful hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一本笔记，全是同样工整的字迹。

examples.en: Good discipline kept the team calm under pressure.
examples.cn: 良好的纪律让团队在压力下保持冷静。

examples.en: She studies two disciplines at once.
examples.cn: 她同时学两门学科。

examples.en: The teacher disciplined the class firmly.
examples.cn: 老师严格管教了这个班。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 discipline 记成「地是三坡林」：地在三面坡上，林子里的人也得排好队，讲的就是纪律。

root: 来自拉丁语 disciplina（教导），词根是 discere（学习），同源词 discipulus 指学习者。它先指对心智与行为的训练，后来既指一群人遵守的秩序，也指学校里的一门学问，还引申为用惩罚来纠正。

sensesIntro.en: From a body trained to stand in line, to a mind trained in one field, to the hand that corrects.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被训练得站成一条线的身体，到在一个领域受训的心，再到那只纠正人的手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: rows of people standing still at the sound of a whistle.
core.cn: 核心意象：哨声一响，一排排人静静站定。

branches.en: The first sense is the order that training produces.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是训练带来的秩序。

branches.en: The second sense is the field a trained mind works in.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是受训的心所钻研的领域。

branches.en: The third sense is the correction that keeps the order.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是维持秩序的纠正。

branches.en: A trained body and a trained mind follow the same habit.
branches.cn: 受训的身体和心智，遵循同一种习惯。

branches.en: Without correction, the line slowly bends.
branches.cn: 没有纠正，那条线就会慢慢弯掉。

intro.en: Discipline gathers the discip- family, words about learning, order and correction.
intro.cn: discipline 聚起 discip 一族词，围绕学习、秩序与纠正。

latinIntro.en: Latin discere, to learn, gives discipulus, a learner, and disciplina, teaching.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 discere（学习）给出 discipulus（学习者）与 disciplina（教导）。

items.example: The school is known for its discipline.
items.exampleCN: 这所学校以纪律严明著称。

items.meaning: a learner who follows a teacher
items.example: He was a disciple of the old master.
items.exampleCN: 他是那位老大师的弟子。

items.example: She is a disciplined worker.
items.exampleCN: 她是个自律的工人。

items.example: The company began a disciplinary hearing.
items.exampleCN: 公司开始了纪律听证。

items.meaning: a person who enforces strict rules
items.example: The coach was a firm disciplinarian.
items.exampleCN: 这位教练纪律要求很严。

items.meaning: the act of training or correcting
items.example: Disciplining a child takes patience.
items.exampleCN: 管教孩子需要耐心。

items.meaning: fields of study or sets of rules
items.example: The library serves many disciplines.
items.exampleCN: 这座图书馆服务许多学科。

items.example: The undisciplined crowd pushed forward.
items.exampleCN: 没有秩序的人群往前挤。

definition_en: to make known information that was hidden or secret
core_image: 一只手把压在抽屉底的文件抽出来，放到灯下
scene: 记者把录音笔往前推了推，对面的人终于松了口。The company refused to disclose the terms of the deal.
sceneCN: 这里 disclose 指「透露」（第 1 个义项：把隐藏的信息说出来）；句意是公司拒绝透露交易条款。

senses.title: To make information known
senses.definition: to give out facts that were not known to others
senses.definitionCN: 把别人不知道的事实说出来
senses.example: The company refused to disclose the terms of the deal.
senses.exampleCN: 公司拒绝透露交易条款。
senses.why: A fact kept behind a door changes the moment the door opens.
senses.whyCN: 关在门后的事实，在门开的那一刻就变了。

senses.title: To expose a hidden truth
senses.definition: to reveal something wrong or secret that was covered up
senses.definitionCN: 把被掩盖的错误或秘密揭出来
senses.example: The report disclosed serious failures in the system.
senses.exampleCN: 报告揭露了系统中的严重失职。
senses.why: What was buried is suddenly standing in daylight.
senses.whyCN: 原本被埋着的东西，忽然站到了日光下。

senses.title: To uncover to view
senses.definition: to remove a cover so that something can be seen
senses.definitionCN: 揭开遮挡，让某物能被看见
senses.example: The curtain rose and disclosed a bare stage.
senses.exampleCN: 幕布升起，露出空荡的舞台。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply cloth pulled away from a thing.
senses.whyCN: 最老的意思，不过是把布从东西上拉开。

intro.en: Disclose is dis-, the reverse of an action, plus close, from Latin claudere, to shut.
intro.cn: disclose 是表示反动作的 dis- 加 close，而 close 来自拉丁语 claudere（关闭）。

items.en: Claudere meant to shut or to close a door.
items.cn: claudere 指关闭或把门合上。

items.en: Clos meant shut or enclosed, and gave English close.
items.cn: clos 指关闭的、围住的，给出英语 close。

items.en: Disclose first meant to open something that was shut.
items.cn: disclose 最初指把关着的东西打开。

items.en: The word turned toward secrets and hidden facts.
items.cn: 这个词转向秘密与隐藏的事实。

items.en: It now covers company reports and official records.
items.cn: 如今它常用于公司报告与官方记录。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the close stem, while the meaning group names other ways of bringing facts to light.
note.cn: 形近组共用 close 这一段词干，近义组则列出其他让事实见光的说法。

entries.definition: to shut something
entries.definitionCN: 把某物关上

entries.definition: the act of shutting something for good
entries.definitionCN: 永久关闭的行为

entries.definition: to put something inside an envelope or a wall
entries.definitionCN: 把某物装进信封或围在墙内

entries.definition: to make something hidden visible or known
entries.definitionCN: 使隐藏之物可见或可知

entries.definition: to uncover something wrong or harmful
entries.definitionCN: 揭出错误或有害之事

entries.definition: to make a private fact known
entries.definitionCN: 把私密的事实说出去

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a locked drawer to a curtain lifted off a stage.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从锁着的抽屉，走到从舞台上拉开的幕布。

normal.en: Dis- reverses close: what was shut is opened.
normal.cn: dis- 把 close 反过来：关上的被打开。

normal.en: To disclose a fact is to take the lid off it.
normal.cn: 透露一个事实，就是把盖子掀开。

normal.en: A company must disclose what it would rather hide.
normal.cn: 公司必须公开它宁愿藏起来的东西。

normal.en: The curtain discloses the stage before the play.
normal.cn: 开演前，幕布把舞台显露出来。

normal.en: The word keeps a trace of the door it once opened.
normal.cn: 这个词还留着它当初打开的那扇门的影子。

abstract.en: Picture a file pulled from the bottom of a drawer.
abstract.cn: 想象一份文件从抽屉底层被抽出来。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp switched on over a dark table.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯在暗桌上亮起。

abstract.en: Picture a curtain rising on an empty stage.
abstract.cn: 想象幕布在空舞台上缓缓升起。

examples.en: The company refused to disclose the terms of the deal.
examples.cn: 公司拒绝透露交易条款。

examples.en: The report disclosed serious failures in the system.
examples.cn: 报告揭露了系统中的严重失职。

examples.en: He disclosed the source of the money.
examples.cn: 他公开了这笔钱的来源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 disclose 记成「的士克漏字」：的士上漏掉的那个字被翻出来，就是揭露。

root: 由表示反动作的 dis- 加 close 构成。close 来自拉丁语 claudere（关闭），经古法语 clos 进入英语。disclose 字面就是「把关着的打开」，先指掀开遮挡让人看见，后来专指把秘密、事实或记录公开出来。

sensesIntro.en: From a fact let out, to a wrong exposed, to a curtain lifted from a stage.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被说出来的事实，到被揭出的错误，再到从舞台上拉开的幕布。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a locked drawer opened and a file brought into the light.
core.cn: 核心意象：锁着的抽屉被打开，文件拿到灯下。

branches.en: The first sense is unknown facts given out.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把未知的事实说出来。

branches.en: The second sense is a covered wrong exposed.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把被掩盖的错误揭出来。

branches.en: The third sense is a cover simply lifted.
branches.cn: 第三个义项只是把遮挡掀开。

branches.en: A fact and a fault both wait behind the same door.
branches.cn: 事实和过失，都等在同一扇门后。

branches.en: Once the cover is gone, what was hidden must be faced.
branches.cn: 遮挡一撤，藏着的东西就得被面对。

intro.en: Disclose belongs to the close family, words about shutting and opening.
intro.cn: disclose 属于 close 一族，围绕关闭与打开。

latinIntro.en: Latin claudere, to shut, gives close, closure, enclose and disclose.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 claudere（关闭）给出 close、closure、enclose 与 disclose。

items.meaning: to open up a hidden fact
items.example: The letter disclosed the truth at last.
items.exampleCN: 那封信终于揭露了真相。

items.example: Please close the window before you leave.
items.exampleCN: 走之前请把窗关上。

items.meaning: the act of shutting for good
items.example: The closure of the factory hurt the town.
items.exampleCN: 工厂关闭让小镇受了打击。

items.example: They enclosed a photo with the letter.
items.exampleCN: 他们在信里附了一张照片。

items.meaning: the act of making something known
items.example: The disclosure shocked the investors.
items.exampleCN: 这一披露震动了投资者。

items.example: The disclosed figures were lower than expected.
items.exampleCN: 公布的数字低于预期。

items.example: Disclosing the names could put them at risk.
items.exampleCN: 公布这些名字可能让他们陷入危险。

items.example: The sum remained undisclosed.
items.exampleCN: 那笔金额始终没有公开。

definition_en: a reduction in price, to reduce a price, or to treat something as unlikely
core_image: 价签上原来的数字被划掉，旁边用红笔写了一个更小的数
scene: 收银台前排着队，店员把标价牌翻过来，背面写着另一个数字。The shop gave students a ten per cent discount.
sceneCN: 这里 discount 指「折扣」（第 1 个义项：从原价减去的部分）；句意是这家店给学生打九折。

collocations.phrase: a discount of ten per cent

senses.title: An amount taken off a price
senses.definition: a sum by which a price is lowered
senses.definitionCN: 从原价里减掉的那一部分钱
senses.example: The shop gave students a ten per cent discount.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店给学生打九折。
senses.why: The same object asks for less because of who is buying.
senses.whyCN: 同样的东西，因为买的人不同，就要得少一些。

senses.title: To lower a price
senses.definition: to sell something at a lower price than usual
senses.definitionCN: 以低于平常的价格出售
senses.example: The old stock was discounted by half.
senses.exampleCN: 旧货打了对折。
senses.why: A number is crossed out so that a smaller one can speak.
senses.whyCN: 划掉一个数字，好让更小的那个说话。

senses.title: To treat something as unlikely
senses.definition: to decide that a story or a risk need not be taken seriously
senses.definitionCN: 认为某个说法或风险不必当真
senses.example: We should not discount the risk of delay.
senses.exampleCN: 我们不该轻视延误的风险。
senses.why: The mind also crosses out what it does not wish to count.
senses.whyCN: 脑子也会划掉它不愿计入的东西。

intro.en: Discount came from dis- plus count, literally to count off a part, and passed through Italian and French.
intro.cn: discount 是 dis- 加 count，字面是「扣掉一部分再算」，经意大利语与法语传来。

items.en: Computare meant to reckon together, the base of count.
items.cn: computare 指合起来计算，是 count 的词源。

items.en: Disconto named a sum counted off from a debt.
items.cn: disconto 指从欠款里扣掉的数目。

items.en: Descompte carried the money sense into French trade.
items.cn: descompte 把这个钱的用法带进法国商业。

items.en: Discount named money taken off a price.
items.cn: discount 指从价钱里减去的钱。

items.en: The verb widened to mean treating an idea as not worth counting.
items.cn: 动词义后来扩展到「不把某个说法算进去」。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the count stem, while the meaning group names other price cuts.
note.cn: 形近组共用 count 这一段词干，近义组则列出其他减价说法。

entries.definition: to say numbers in order or to include something
entries.definitionCN: 按顺序数数，或把某物算进去

entries.definition: a record of money kept at a bank
entries.definitionCN: 银行里的存款记录

entries.definition: able to be counted one by one
entries.definitionCN: 可以逐个计数的

entries.definition: a lowering of price or amount
entries.definitionCN: 价格或数量的降低

entries.definition: money returned after a payment
entries.definitionCN: 付款后退回的一部分钱

entries.definition: an amount taken away from a total
entries.definitionCN: 从总数中扣除的数额

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from a crossed-out price to a risk that is quietly left out of the count.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从被划掉的价格，走到被悄悄排除在计算之外的风险。

normal.en: Dis- plus count: count a little less.
normal.cn: dis- 加 count：少算一点。

normal.en: A discount is a number crossed out with a smile.
normal.cn: 折扣就是一个被笑着划掉的数字。

normal.en: Student discount asks who you are before what you buy.
normal.cn: 学生优惠先问你是谁，再问你买什么。

normal.en: To discount a warning is to leave it out of the sum.
normal.cn: 轻视一个警告，就是把它从总数里漏掉。

normal.en: The same word lowers a price and lowers a risk.
normal.cn: 同一个词，既压低价钱，也压低风险的分量。

abstract.en: Picture a red line through an old price.
abstract.cn: 想象旧价钱上划过一道红线。

abstract.en: Picture a smaller number written in the corner.
abstract.cn: 想象角落里写着一个更小的数。

abstract.en: Picture a warning note moved to the bottom of a pile.
abstract.cn: 想象一张警告纸条被挪到一摞纸的最下面。

examples.en: The shop gave students a ten per cent discount.
examples.cn: 这家店给学生打九折。

examples.en: The old stock was discounted by half.
examples.cn: 旧货打了对折。

examples.en: We should not discount the risk of delay.
examples.cn: 我们不该轻视延误的风险。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 discount 记成「的士扛」：的士费太贵，扛着东西走，店家只好给个折扣。

root: 由 dis-（去掉）加 count（计算）构成，字面意思是「扣掉一部分再算」。这个词经意大利语 disconto 与法语 descompte 进入英语，先指从欠款或价钱里减去的数目，后来也作动词表示打折，并引申为把某种说法或风险排除在考虑之外。

sensesIntro.en: From money taken off a price, to the act of lowering it, to a risk left out of the count.
sensesIntro.cn: 从价钱里减掉的钱，到把价钱压低这个动作，再到被排除在计算之外的风险。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old price crossed out, a smaller number beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧价钱被划掉，旁边写着一个更小的数。

chain: PART OF IT IS STRUCK OUT

branches.en: The first sense is the sum taken off the price.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是从价钱里减掉的那笔钱。

branches.en: The second sense is the act of lowering the price.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是把价钱压低的动作。

branches.en: The third sense is a claim left out of the count.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是被排除在计算之外的说法。

branches.en: The amount and the act both make the number smaller.
branches.cn: 金额与动作，都让那个数字变小。

branches.en: A price and a risk can both be counted for less.
branches.cn: 价钱和风险，都可以被算得更轻。

intro.en: Discount belongs to the count family, words about reckoning and accounts.
intro.cn: discount 属于 count 一族，围绕计算与账目。

latinIntro.en: Latin computare, to reckon together, gives count, account and discount.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 computare（合起来计算）给出 count、account 与 discount。

items.meaning: a sum counted off a price
items.example: The discount brought the price down.
items.exampleCN: 折扣把价钱压低了。

items.meaning: to reckon numbers or include something
items.example: Count the chairs before you order.
items.exampleCN: 订之前先数数椅子。

items.meaning: a record of money or an explanation
items.example: He opened an account at the bank.
items.exampleCN: 他在银行开了个账户。

items.meaning: a person who keeps financial records
items.example: The accountant checked every receipt.
items.exampleCN: 会计核对了每张收据。

items.example: Apples are countable nouns.
items.exampleCN: 苹果是可数名词。

items.meaning: not able to be counted one by one
items.example: Water is an uncountable noun.
items.exampleCN: water 是不可数名词。

items.example: The countdown began at ten.
items.exampleCN: 倒计时从十开始。

items.meaning: able to be sold at a lower price
items.example: These goods are not discountable.
items.exampleCN: 这些商品不打折。
